author: Forbes
description:
De Soi CEO Scout Brisson explains why building a strong network is one of the most important parts of starting a company.⁣

When you’re building, you don’t have to figure everything out alone. Being able to tap into other people’s experience whether it’s quick feedback, a second opinion or help thinking through a problem can move things forward faster.⁣
title: Why Your Network Is Your Biggest Advantage as a Founder
